interactionRules.lockedTap: when an explanation/detail exists, keep the node operable and announce full lock reason; do not expose disabled semantics
interactionRules.currentTap: one action route to exact station start/resume
interactionRules.completedTap: open review only if domain route exists
interactionRules.tabReselect: keep route selected; no duplicate stack entry
interactionRules.restoreScroll: keyed by chapter and station; restore after content measurement
interactionRules.singleFeatured: at most one Current node and one featured surface per decision viewport
interactionRules.nav: exactly Path/Practice/Me child tabs; route is owned by the app coordinator; reselect creates no duplicate stack entry
interactionRules.futureNodes: Use the domain node state (normally Locked or Fresh); do not add a synthetic Upcoming domain state.

motion.press: reduce elevation/edge, do not change layout bounds
motion.route: short fade/slide only if reduced motion off
motion.success: only after authoritative evaluator result; no coins or random drops

failure.noCurrent: render exact fresh/placement route state from domain; do not infer first station
failure.offline: offline is normal; only show local content-unavailable when needed
failure.missingAsset: honest fallback with retry/back if real action
failure.invalidProgress: do not show guessed percentages; surface data error to developer diagnostics and child-friendly UI

performance.connector: reuse ShomaraPathGraph deterministic geometry; draw behind nodes
performance.recomposition: hoist state and avoid repository/evaluator work in composition
performance.bitmap: load only visible/needed approved WebP poses
